ML: the mudlark from the reference sheet (skinny boy about ten, messy brown hair, ragged too-big jacket, rolled-up trousers, bare muddy feet, small wicker basket)
PF: the pure finder from the reference sheet (old woman, black bonnet, faded blue dress, patched apron, one leather glove, lidded bucket)

CB: the climbing boy from the reference sheet (small boy about eight, soot-blackened face and clothes, grey cap, small hand brush)
